**Severity:** error · **Area:** Resume (`RV2xxx`) · **Quick fix:** none

## Message

The diagnostic reads:

```text
Mutually recursive functions {names} are separated by an early exit (return / throw / break / continue): their group registers after the last one, so a render leaving early cannot resume them; move the group's functions together before the early exit
```

Parts in braces (`{name}`) are filled in for each report.

## How to fix

Declare every function of the group (the local functions that call each other) next to each other, before any `return` / `throw` / `break` / `continue` of their block, or write them as function declarations (registered at the top of the block).

## Example

```tsx avoid nocheck
import { signal } from "@rivetjs/reactivity";
export function A(props: { a: boolean }) {
  const n = signal(0);
  const even = (k: number): boolean => (k === 0 ? true : odd(k - 1));
  if (props.a) return <b onClick={() => n.set(even(2) ? 1 : 0)}>{n()}</b>;
  const odd = (k: number): boolean => (k === 0 ? false : even(k - 1));
  return <i onClick={() => n.set(odd(3) ? 1 : 0)}>{n()}</i>;
}
```

```tsx prefer
import { signal } from "@rivetjs/reactivity";
export function A(props: { a: boolean }) {
  const n = signal(0);
  const even = (k: number): boolean => (k === 0 ? true : odd(k - 1));
  const odd = (k: number): boolean => (k === 0 ? false : even(k - 1));
  if (props.a) return <b onClick={() => n.set(even(2) ? 1 : 0)}>{n()}</b>;
  return <i onClick={() => n.set(odd(3) ? 1 : 0)}>{n()}</i>;
}
```

## When it is reported

Resume mode (Function Bridge T10): mutually recursive local functions resume as one group, registered once per render after the last `const` member; a render that leaves before that point would write unregistered functions into the page.
